sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The league leaders are looking to bounce back from a recent loss, though their form remains strong overall with seven wins from their last ten matches. Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just four points and arrive in poor form, having won only once all season.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday in a potential title-race statement, with both sides competing for promotion credentials. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash of upper-mid-table sides, while Wolverhampton Casuals—themselves in contention—face Wednesfield Community at home before a midweek trip to Brereton Social on Wednesday. Bilston Town's in-form streak continues as they visit Foley Meir. Lower down the table, Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a basement-six encounter, while Brereton Social (hosting Widnes Town) and Market Drayton Town (away to New Mills) both seek wins to climb away from the relegation zone. Shawbury United continue their five-game losing run with a home fixture against Barnton, and Crewe host Allscott Heath as both search for consistency.
